rejected.claim: Amazon S3 Vectors is now generally available in all commercial AWS Regions, offering native vector storage and similarity query support for AI workloads.
rejected.reason: The AWS page does not back "is generally available (status)" (the page sentence "Amazon S3 Vectors is available in preview in the US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt), and Asia Pacific (Sydney) Regions." says preview, a different status; no quote says generally available); "in all commercial AWS Regions (scope)" (that sentence lists only five Regions, a narrower scope); "similarity query support" (the page sentence "Amazon S3 Vectors is the first cloud object store with native support to store and query vectors, delivering purpose-built, cost-optimized vector storage for AI agents, AI inference, and semantic search." says query vectors but never mentions similarity; not backed strictly).
